sources.title: IBM AI models
sources.snippet: Choosing the right model matters to your AI applications, your brand and your bottom line. IBM gives you the freedom to choose from thousands of models from leading providers and select the one that best fits your use case, whether it's IBM® Granite®, third-party options or your own custom models.

sources.title: InterServer MCP Server: Connect AI Agents to Hosting
sources.snippet: The InterServer MCP server lets compatible AI assistants connect to InterServer hosting tools through the Model Context Protocol. It gives AI clients a structured way to discover supported actions, request authorization, and help with hosting-related workflows without scraping pages or guessing API calls.
